title: Explicit share of plays
statementMd:
What percentage of all plays were of explicit tracks (rounded to 1 decimal)?

Expected columns: `explicit_pct`.

Tables: `artists`, `albums`, `tracks`, `listeners`, `plays`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(t.explicit) / COUNT(*), 1) AS explicit_pct FROM plays p JOIN tracks t ON t.id = p.track_id;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
